easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
description:
Activate The Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping and exiling it, putting an enlightened counter on an Angel you control.
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to the Angel with the enlightened counter on it.
Step 3 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
